# Feature: Brief Protocol & Document Model

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-013
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan_v2.md` (row FEAT-013; §4 domain concepts Brief/Source/Citation; §5 Brief Shape sketch; §7 "The Brief is the one output contract"; refactor context — supersedes the `AskCard` contract from `plan.md` FEAT-007)

The **Brief** is v2's universal output document: a single, synthesized, progressively-disclosable answer with an answer-first `overview`, scannable `key_findings`, deep `sections`, structured `facets` (comparison tables), numbered deduplicated `sources`, honest `notices`, and run `metadata`. Every user-facing surface (`ask`, `research`, `run` results, `do`) will converge on this one schema.

This feature delivers the **contract only** — the Zod schema in `packages/protocol`, its JSON Schema emission, TS types, builder helpers, citation-integrity validation, and the `0.1 → 0.2` schema-version bump. Consumers arrive in FEAT-014 (synthesizer produces Briefs) and FEAT-015 (renderer consumes them, `ask` cutover deletes `AskCard`).

**Refactor context (already-implemented baseline):** today's user-facing result type is `AskCard` in `packages/core/src/extraction/types.ts` — a per-source card with a first-N-sentence summary. It is **not** a protocol type (it never crossed the trust boundary), which is part of the problem this feature fixes: the output document becomes a first-class, versioned, schema-validated protocol artifact like `Plan` and `TaskEvent`. `AskCard` stays alive until the FEAT-015 cutover; this feature must not break it.

**New structural guarantee introduced here:** _no uncited claims_ — the schema itself enforces referential integrity (every citation index must resolve to a declared source), and exposes the validation hooks FEAT-014's citation-faithfulness validator builds on.

## 2. Data Model (Granular)

> No `.spec-lite/data_model.md` exists — granular model designed here from plan §4/§5. This is a **protocol document model** (Zod), not relational storage. Persistence is `runs/<run-id>/brief.json` (canonical file, written by the pipeline in FEAT-015).

### Entities & Attributes

- **Brief** (`packages/protocol/src/schemas/brief.ts`):
  - `brief_id` (string, ULID) — unique document id. NOT NULL.
  - `task_id` (string, ULID) — originating task. NOT NULL.
  - `schema_version` (literal `"0.2"`) — version stamp for forward migration.
  - `title` (string, min 1) — one-line document title.
  - `overview` (string, Markdown) — answer-first synthesis, 1–3 paragraphs, inline `[n]` citations. NOT NULL (deterministic path always produces one).
  - `key_findings` (KeyFinding[], min 0) — scannable bullets.
  - `sections` (Section[], min 0) — deep-detail prose, empty at `--detail overview` synthesis budget.
  - `facets` (Facets | null) — structured/tabular data; `null` when the query has no comparative shape.
  - `sources` (Source[], min 0) — numbered, deduplicated references.
  - `metadata` (BriefMetadata) — provenance and quality signals.
  - `notices` (Notice[], min 0) — honest per-source failures and validator flags.
- **KeyFinding**:
  - `text` (string, Markdown, min 1) — the finding.
  - `citations` (int[] ≥1 each) — indexes into `sources[].n`. Min length 1 **unless** `editorial: true`.
  - `editorial` (boolean, default false) — explicit marker for uncited synthesis commentary (the only legal uncited form).
  - `facet` (record<string, string | number | boolean | null> | null) — optional structured payload (e.g., `{ price: 328, in_stock: true }`).
- **Section**:
  - `heading` (string, min 1), `body_md` (string, Markdown — **no raw ANSI escapes**, enforced by refinement), `citations` (int[]).
- **Facets**:
  - `comparison` ({ `columns`: string[] min 1, `rows`: (string | number | boolean | null)[][] } | null) — every row length must equal `columns.length` (refinement).
- **Source**:
  - `n` (int ≥1) — citation number; contiguous `1..N` in array order (refinement).
  - `url` (string url), `final_url` (string url | null) — post-redirect landing.
  - `host` (string, min 1), `title` (string | null), `fetched_at` (ISO datetime), `published_at` (ISO datetime | null).
- **BriefMetadata**:
  - `search_provider` (string | null), `synthesis` (`'deterministic' | 'llm'`), `deterministic_fallback_used` (boolean),
  - `coverage` (number 0–1 | null), `freshness` (string | null),
  - `citation_verdict` ({ `claims_checked`: int, `flagged`: int, `stripped`: int } | null) — filled by FEAT-014's validator,
  - `usage` ({ `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`: int ≥0, `cost_usd`: number ≥0 } | null) — `null` on the deterministic path,
  - `run_id` (string | null).
- **Notice**:
  - `source` (string) — host or subsystem, `reason` (string, min 1), `kind` (`'fetch_failed' | 'extract_failed' | 'blocked' | 'uncited_claim_stripped' | 'uncited_claim_flagged' | 'budget_exhausted' | 'other'`).

### Relationships

- Brief 1:N Source (embedded array; dedup by `final_url ?? url` is the producer's job, asserted by refinement: no duplicate normalized URLs).
- KeyFinding/Section N:M Source via `citations[]` → `Source.n` (referential integrity refined in-schema).
- Task 1:1 Brief (`task_id`); Run 1:1 Brief (`metadata.run_id`) — enforced by producers, not the schema.

### Indexes & Constraints (schema refinements, `superRefine`)

- Every `citations[]` entry must exist in `sources[].n` — **the** integrity rule (mirrors the `extractionResultEnvelope` total-rows refinement pattern in `packages/protocol/src/schemas/extraction.ts`).
- `sources[].n` strictly ascending, contiguous from 1; no duplicate normalized URLs.
- `key_findings[]` with `editorial: false` must have ≥1 citation.
- `comparison.rows[i].length === comparison.columns.length`.
- `overview`/`body_md`/`text` must not contain ANSI escape bytes (``) — plan §8 "no raw ANSI in Brief payloads".
- Protocol package convention: **`null` for absence, never `undefined`** (memory §Coding Standards); every field `.describe()`d (memory §Documentation).

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: N/A — pure schema package.
- **Error Handling**: `validateBrief` returns `Result<Brief, BriefValidationError>` (never throws); error carries zod paths for bounded re-prompt use by FEAT-014's LLM path (max-2-retries convention from memory).
- **Logging**: N/A at this layer — synthesis/citation events are FEAT-014's concern; this feature only defines the `citation_verdict` metadata slot they fill.
- **Security**: the schema is the enforcement surface for two plan §6 rules — no-uncited-claims (refinements) and clean payloads (no-ANSI refinement keeps `--json`/`brief.md` inert). No PII fields exist in the schema by design; `sources` carry only public URL metadata.
